reason: Conversation 2 immediately and correctly explained 22E as a fridge/evaporator fan fault, tied the ticking/scraping noise to ice on the fan, and gave the sensible first step (a full unplugged 24-48h manual defrost) with safe food handling and a clear escalation path to an engineer if the code recurs. Conversation 1 never explained the code, repeated the same settings and vent-blocking questions after the customer had already answered, misread '9C' as a code, and spent nine turns on generic checks without reaching the defrost test or any escalation advice. Neither conversation breached the safety boundary, but Conversation 1 was inefficient and unhelpful while Conversation 2 was accurate, honest about the possible failed-part outcome, and appropriately did not recommend a part without diagnosis.
